name: EmptyState
summary: Type-led message for empty collections. Headline + supporting line + optional primary action. When this owns the page's primary CTA, the PageHeader CTA hides via data-cta-suppressed='true'. Closes chat 36-A item #3.

icon.description: 24×24 lucide icon, rendered inside a 40×40 framed circle. Aria-hidden.

headline.description: Single-line headline. Max 40 chars. Voice: 'No X yet' / 'No X match Y' — never 'Oops'.

supporting.description: Optional supporting line. Max 60ch. Two lines max — explain WHY empty + how to fix.

primaryAction.description: Optional one primary action. {label, onClick} or {label, href}. Label MUST lead with a verb.

tertiaryLink.description: Optional subordinate text link. Avoid two equal-weight actions.

tone.description: 'default' = dashed border; 'subtle' = solid hairline (use inside a Card).

compact.description: true = icon suppressed + smaller padding, for inline-row use.

keyboard: Tab — focus the primary action (when present)
rules: role='region' with aria-labelledby pointing to the headline element's id.
The primaryAction label carries the meaning ('Quote a lane', not 'Click here').

do: Two lines max — headline + one supporting line.
Lead action label with a verb. 'Quote a lane' > 'Get started'.
Honor 'one primary action per view' — when this owns the CTA, PageHeader CTA hides.
Use tone='subtle' when nested inside a Card that's already framed.
dont: Don't illustrate the empty state — no character 'looking sad', no smiley SVG.
Don't say 'Oops' or 'Uh-oh.' — see microcopy.md banned phrases.
Don't put two actions of equal weight. One primary + optional tertiary link.
Don't use EmptyState for an error state — that's Banner status='danger'.
Don't use EmptyState for a loading state — that's Skeleton / Spinner.
Don't write inline 'bg-[var(--color-accent-500)] text-[var(--color-text-on-accent,white)]' on the CTA button — use .lumen-btn-primary.

changelog.note: Contract beefed up. Added tone / align / compact / tertiaryLink props. Aligned with .lumen-empty-state defensive class. Tied to PageHeader's data-cta-suppressed contract.
